title: TimeMaster: Training Time-Series Multimodal LLMs to Reason via Reinforcement Learning

claim.summary: TimeMaster post-trains a multimodal LLM to classify time-series plots and produce structured reasoning and domain-specific extensions using SFT followed by GRPO.

tasks.source_label: temporal question answering; time series classification

modules.name: Structured time-series reasoning post-training
modules.scope_reason: SFT and GRPO update the multimodal language model with format, class correctness and extension-quality rewards.
